title: Profile photo viewer
summary: Shows a person's or a group's photo full screen, with pinch and double-tap zoom, and closes (bipe-chat/bipe#829).

name.description: The person or group name, as the opening screen shows it. Spoken as the image label.

mxcUrl.description: The Matrix avatar. Loaded as a large thumbnail (MediaLoader.thumbnail).

publicPhotoUrl.description: The public profile photo, when there is no Matrix avatar.

phase.description: failed: no image loaded; the screen shows the name only.

close.effect: The close button, or a swipe down on iOS and back on Android: back to the opening screen.

notes: Opens from spec person-profile and spec group-details (action openPhoto). The avatar there is a button labelled bipe_avatar_open.
No save and no share: the photo belongs to someone else (privacy). Your own photo changes in spec profile-edit, not here.
Black background in both themes, like spec media-viewer.
